title: Dashboard
quick_actions_desc: Shortcuts to the most used pages. Click any button to go directly.
no_organizations: You do not belong to any organization
no_departments: You do not belong to any department
balance_explanation: Positive balance = you have credit (they owe you). Negative balance = you owe (it is normal, you will pay later). E.g.: -80 means you received 80 {{currency}} in goods that you will compensate later.
federated_nodes_explanation: Communities connected to yours for exchange. E.g.: 3 means you can transfer with users from 3 different communities.
warnings_explanation: Federation limit warnings near the cap. E.g.: 2 means you are approaching the limit with 2 nodes.
limit_warnings_desc: These alerts indicate that you are approaching the debt or credit limit with other nodes.
connected_nodes_desc: List of federated communities and the balance with each one. Negative balance = you owe that community. Positive balance = they owe you.
no_federated_nodes_desc: To federate with another community, go to Federation Limits and register a remote node.
organizations_desc: Organizations where you have a role. You enter with your user and the organization knows who you are and what you can do.
departments_desc: Commissions and departments where you are a member. You enter with your user and see according to your role.
help_what_is_desc: The Dashboard is the home screen of your node. It is the first page you see when you log in. It shows a quick summary of your personal account status and the federated network you belong to. It serves to see at a glance how much you have, how much you owe, and how your community is doing.
help_what_for_1: See your current balance in Trueques ({{currency}})
help_what_for_2: Know if you are approaching credit or debit limits
help_what_for_3: See how many communities are federated with yours
help_what_for_4: Quickly access the most common actions (transfer, view history, etc.)
help_how_to_use_desc: Simply look at the three cards above to see your balance, federated nodes, and warnings. If there are warnings (number in orange), check the Limit Warnings section below. Use the Quick Actions buttons to go directly to the most used pages without searching the menu.
help_balance_card: My Balance Card - What does it show?
help_balance_card_desc: It shows your current balance in Trueques ({{currency}}). This number can be:
help_balance_positive_desc: You have credit. Someone owes you or you received payments. It means the community owes you goods/services for that amount.
help_balance_negative_desc: You owe the community. It is completely normal: it means you received goods/services and will pay later by selling or working. It is not a bad debt, it is like a revolving credit.
help_balance_zero_desc: You have not made transactions yet, or your income and expenses compensated exactly.
help_balance_example: Example: If your balance is -80 {{currency}}, it means you have received 80 {{currency}} in goods/services that you have not yet compensated.
help_what_is_balance_desc: The balance is the sum of all your transactions. Every time you receive Trueques, it goes up. Every time you send, it goes down. The system works like double-entry accounting: what one gives, another receives. The sum of all balances of all users always equals zero. No one creates money from nothing.
help_limits_title: What do the credit and debit limits mean?
help_limits_intro: Below the balance you will see two numbers:
help_credit_limit_desc: It is the maximum you can have in your favor. If your balance reaches +1000, you cannot receive more until you spend something. It prevents a single person from accumulating too much credit without contributing.
help_debit_limit_desc: It is the maximum you can owe. If your balance reaches -1000, you cannot spend more until you receive Trueques (by selling or working). It prevents someone from buying without limit.
help_limits_example: Example: If your debit limit is -500 and your balance is -480, you can only spend 20 {{currency}} more before reaching the cap.
help_limits_community: These limits are defined by your community and can be adjusted in the node configuration.
help_federated_nodes_card: Federated Nodes Card - What does it show?
help_federated_nodes_desc: It shows how many communities (nodes) are connected to yours through federation. Federation allows exchanging Trueques between different communities. If it says 0, your node is alone and you can only transfer between users of your same community.
help_warnings_card: Active Warnings Card - What does it show?
help_warnings_desc: It shows alerts when you are approaching federation limits (debt or credit with other nodes). If it says 0, there are no problems. If there are warnings, check the Limit Warnings section for details.
help_connected_nodes_desc: Lists each federated community and the balance you have with it:
help_negative_balance_desc: You owe that community. You bought from someone there and will pay later.
help_positive_balance_desc: They owe you. You sold to someone there and will receive later.
help_quick_actions_title: Quick Actions - How to use them?
help_quick_actions_desc: Below the cards there are large buttons that take you directly to the most used pages:
help_buy_desc: View products available in the store
help_quick_actions_tip: Just click the button and it will take you to that page. It is a shortcut to avoid searching the side menu.
